title: Roadrunner Multi-Environment Asset Pack
coordinate_system: Y-up; ground centered around X=0, Z=0; robot start at (0,0,0); ground height at robot start (0,0) is y=0 for all five scenes

files.notes: Continuous heightfield with a rising slope and broad shoulder.
Grass ground plus individually named stepping stones, log and block. Decor_ objects are visual-only.
Undulating sand heightfield with a relatively smoother central corridor.
Concrete sidewalk with raised curb strips and a raised slab.

integration.public_directory: public/environments/ (or ./environments/ if this project serves assets from repository root)
integration.ground_sampling: Find node named Ground and raycast against its mesh. Do not raycast against obstacle nodes when sampling terrain height.
integration.obstacle_detection: Find nodes whose names begin with Obstacle_. Decor_ nodes are visual-only.
integration.important: These are kinematic demonstration assets, not physically validated terrain or collision meshes.
